title: dlarray
summary: Create a dlarray compatibility object around host or gpuArray data.
description: `dlarray(X)` wraps host or provider-resident gpuArray data and optional dimension labels in a RunMat compatibility object.
behaviors: The underlying `Data` value is preserved without conversion, including provider-resident `gpuArray` handles.
A second text argument is stored as `Format` and `Labels`.
Additional constructor options are rejected with explicit compatibility errors.
Automatic differentiation and labeled arithmetic are not implemented in this slice.
gpu_residency: `dlarray` preserves provider-resident `gpuArray` data as wrapper metadata. Labeled tensor execution and Deep Learning kernels over those handles remain future work.
